decisions.reason: The calculator assigns square footage to pricing tiers and calculates bundle estimates, so the confirmed Basic-package prices may need to feed it; however, the calculator is deferred and the source exchange does not explicitly connect these prices to its calculation logic.
The candidate concerns itemized individual-service pricing, while the source confirms square-footage prices for the Basic package; its existing transparency and selection behavior remains unchanged.
Changing Basic-package price amounts does not alter the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
Package prices do not affect gallery hover-animation behavior.
The navigation to detailed pricing information remains valid without modification when the destination's displayed prices change.
The confirmed package prices do not change gallery categories or the optional other-photography area.
Package pricing values do not affect the homepage hero image emphasis or overlay presentation.
The package pricing decision is unrelated to interactive gallery scrolling.
Confirming Basic-package prices does not change the requirement to accompany each service with representative imagery.
The package pricing values do not alter the site's image-focused presentation style.
